## Conference Presentations

This list includes upcoming presentations.

Role markers:

- `○`: Discussant
- `●`: Poster
- `■`: Session chair

Papers presented: *Why fadeout is (probably) worse than we think: Adjusting for correlated sampling error in meta-analyses of behavioral interventions*, [paper](https://edworkingpapers.com/ai26-1394); *Measures still matter: Replicating and extending a meta-analysis of the effects of educational apps on children's reading and math skills with six years of new data*.
